strengths: first-party state compounds through workout history and progress
shareable outputs such as streaks, PRs, plans and progress summaries are natural
premium value can attach to analysis, progression, planning and coaching
owned utility gets stronger with accumulated history
risks: strong incumbents already own activity graphs and social proof
health/fitness claims require careful safety boundaries
sensor/device integration can increase implementation complexity
candidates.small_test_shape: character-led short-form workout content -> deep link to a simple owned workout/progress state -> immediate useful action -> save progress -> next-session recommendation -> shareable progress artifact

strengths: shopping lists, timers, meal plans and saved recipes create owned utility
risks: social recipe import and meal-planning competition is already dense
differentiation must come from brand, workflow depth or unique utility rather than import alone
candidates.small_test_shape: character-led short-form recipe content -> deep link to exact recipe/cook mode -> save state -> shopping/timer utility -> next meal suggestion -> shareable result

why: history/state compounds more strongly over time
premium value can attach to progress and analysis rather than content access alone
the three-engine loop depends less on a single external social platform
disqualifier: This is not a winner declaration. No measured conversion, retention, CAC or profit evidence exists yet.

identify incumbent gaps not solved by Strava/Nike/general AI

freeze pre-test success thresholds before any governed live test
